title: FusionSense Recorded ESP32 Replay
disclosure: Every prediction fuses real synchronized ESP32 IMU and ESP32-CAM pose data. Windows missing either input are withheld, not predicted.

model.name: FusionSense corrected masked IMU + camera fusion
model.scope_note: Four-subject research pilot; not a clinical or safety-certified device.

input_contract.fusion_policy: valid IMU and valid camera pose required

radar.note: Not an input to this project
